name: livestock-desktop
description: Livestock Manager PREMIUM - app de escritorio nativa (Tauri) para gestion ganadera.

scripts.build:msix: npm run sync && npm run prebuild:premium && powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path src-tauri/target/msix) { Remove-Item src-tauri/target/msix -Recurse -Force }" && tauri-windows-bundle build
scripts.postbuild:msix: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$b = Get-ChildItem src-tauri/target/msix -Filter *.msixbundle -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $b) { Write-Host 'ERROR: no se genero ningun .msixbundle'; exit 1 }; Write-Host ('MSIX generado: ' + $b[0].Name)"
